info.name: Oracle EBS e-Commerce Gateway Accounts Payable Service Discovery API
Retrieve Wadl Description for a Deployed Service

params.name: serviceAlias
params.description: The alias of the deployed REST service

params.name: WADL
params.description: Flag to request the WADL description

items.docs: Returns the WADL (Web Application Description Language) document describing the available methods, parameters, and data types for the specified deployed REST service.
